summary: This plugin is a DeepSeek Harness Web GUI skin and layout enhancement that customizes wallpaper, panel transparency, and interface behavior, with added front-end archive and @-mention utilities for files and sessions.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily a user-facing interface customization plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, centered on themes and layout adjustments such as wallpaper, panel transparency, and message/input/scroll behavior. It also adds UI-side utilities via plugin APIs (archived session actions and file mentions), which is secondary to its main skinting goal, so it is conservatively classified under themes-layout with moderate local filesystem, network, and session-management impact.
